NewsArticle.Title: Events of Temuair
NewsArticle.Content:
Mundanes list public events held in Temuair. The mundanes gossip about these events everywhere. To hear their gossip, click the second button on the farthest right, where you find mail in your home village's shops.
- Religious Masses
- Guild Activities
- University Classes
- Festivals
- Bardic Circles
- Adventures, Quests, Greater Geas
To submit your group's event:
- Goto [www.darkages.com/news](http://www.darkages.com/news)
- Click 'Submit news' from the top.
- Give all this information. It will be gossiped about in 2-4 business days if you wrote all these details:
- Date, Time, and Time Zone
- Character Name point of contact
- Name of the event
- Requirements to attend
- Duration of the event
- Location
- Any other details you would like posted. The event will be posted exactly as written if possible.
See [all](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html) features screenshots.
